description: MainActivity class for an Android Tic Tac Toe app, responsible for rendering the board, managing gameplay, updating UI, and handling state persistence.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing UI for Tic Tac Toe game, handling lifecycle, user interactions, and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, restores state if available, and sets up event listeners for game interactions.

methods.name: wireUpBoard
methods.description: Assigns click listeners to board cells to handle player moves.

methods.name: updateUIFromEngine
methods.description: Refreshes board display, scoreboard, and game status based on current game engine state.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Dynamically retrieves layout resource ID by name.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Dynamically retrieves view ID resource by name.

methods.name: getStringByName
methods.description: Dynamically retrieves string resource by name.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current game state to handle configuration changes like screen rotations.
